quest.title: Wishes Contended, Fortunes Won
quest.description: You come across a strange stall in Liyue Harbor...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Guilan
dialogues.text: Step right up and take a look! Play a round of "Wishes Contended, Fortunes Won" and ring in a year of good luck!

dialogues.speaker: Guilan
dialogues.text: Oh, it's the brand new mini-game released by the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Guilan
dialogues.text: With the "Prosperity Pouch" and "Charm Coins," just a little skill is all it takes to bring you luck and good fortune!

dialogues.speaker: Guilan
dialogues.text: If you'd like to try them and bring yourself some good fortune, you're always welcome here!
